rv.q: She appears, trailing her wedding dress, with an almost matter-of-fact inevitability, having paced around the upstairs bedroom like Ibsen’s John Gabriel Borkman. The Chicago Steppenwolf veteran and Roseanne co-star Laurie Metcalf is brilliant throughout despite the handicap of a terrible Wurzel Gummidge white wig at the end (why do they do this?).
